story.label: Origin
story.heading: Our Story
quotes: “I started SyvurSoft after working for years in busy emergency rooms and ICUs. As a doctor, I kept facing the same problem - we had to make quick decisions with complex patient data, especially blood gas results.”
“I looked for tools to help with this, but couldn't find anything that was both accurate and easy to use in high-pressure situations. So I decided to build one myself.”

“This led to ABGen, our first app that helps doctors quickly understand blood gas results. We designed it to be simple enough to use during emergencies but detailed enough to provide valuable insights.”

whyWeStarted.title: Why We Started
whyWeStarted.text: We started SyvurSoft to make better medical software. As doctors, we know how hard it can be to make quick decisions with complex patient data. Our goal is simple: create tools that make doctors' lives easier and help patients get better care.
whyWeStarted.quote: “We turn complicated medical data into clear, useful information that helps doctors make better decisions.”

introduction.title: 1. Introduction
before: At SyvurSoft, we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy policy will inform you about how we look after your personal data when you visit our website or use our applications, and tell you about your privacy rights and how the law protects you.
This policy applies to all information collected through our website https://syvursoft.com, our mobile applications ABGen, Atria and any related services, sales, marketing or events.

dataWeCollect.title: 2. Data We Collect
before: When you use ABGen or visit our website, we may collect the following types of information:

items.label: Usage Data:
items.text: Anonymous information about how you use our applications, including features accessed and time spent.

items.label: Device Information:
items.text: Technical data about the device you use to access our services, including device type, operating system, and browser type.

items.label: Contact Information:
items.text: If you contact us for support or participate in our community, we may collect your email address and other contact details you provide.

items.label: Log Data:
items.text: Our servers automatically record information that your browser sends whenever you visit our website, such as your IP address, browser type and version, time zone setting, and pages visited.

items.label: Cookies and Similar Technologies:
items.text: We may use cookies and similar tracking technologies to track activity on our website and hold certain information.

after: We do not collect or store any patient data or protected health information (PHI) entered into ABGen. All clinical calculations are performed locally on your device.

dataUse.title: 3. How We Use Your Data
before: We use the information we collect to:
items: Improve and optimize our applications and services
Provide technical support
Communicate with you about updates and new features
Ensure the security and proper functioning of our applications
Analyze usage patterns to improve user experience
Respond to your requests, questions, and concerns
Comply with applicable laws and regulations
after: We will only use your personal data for the purposes for which we collected it, unless we reasonably consider that we need to use it for another reason compatible with the original purpose.

legalBasis.title: 4. Legal Basis for Processing
before: We will only process your personal data when we have a legal basis to do so. The legal basis will depend on the purposes for which we have collected and use your personal data. In most cases, the legal basis will be one of the following:

items.label: Consent:
items.text: You have given us consent to process your personal data for a specific purpose.

items.label: Contract:
items.text: Processing is necessary for the performance of a contract with you.

items.label: Legitimate Interests:
items.text: Processing is necessary for our legitimate interests or those of a third party, provided those interests are not overridden by your rights and interests.

items.label: Legal Obligation:
items.text: Processing is necessary for compliance with a legal obligation.

sharing.title: 5. Data Sharing and Disclosure
before: We do not sell, trade, or otherwise transfer your personal information to outside parties except in the following circumstances:

items.label: Service Providers:
items.text: We may share your data with trusted third parties who assist us in operating our website, conducting our business, or servicing you, provided those parties agree to keep this information confidential.

items.label: Legal Requirements:
items.text: We may disclose your information where we are legally required to do so to comply with applicable law, governmental requests, judicial proceedings, court orders, or legal processes.

items.label: Business Transfers:
items.text: If we are involved in a merger, acquisition, or sale of all or a portion of our assets, your data may be transferred as part of that transaction.

items.label: With Your Consent:
items.text: We may disclose your personal information for any other purpose with your consent.

security.title: 6. Data Security
before: We implement appropriate security measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. However, no method of transmission over the Internet or electronic storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
Our security measures include:
items: Encryption of sensitive data
Regular security assessments
Access controls and authentication procedures
Secure development practices
after: We limit access to your personal data to those employees, agents, contractors and other third parties who have a business need to know. They will only process your personal data on our instructions and they are subject to a duty of confidentiality.

retention.title: 7. Data Retention
before: We will only retain your personal data for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes we collected it for, including for the purposes of satisfying any legal, accounting, or reporting requirements.
To determine the appropriate retention period for personal data, we consider:
items: The amount, nature, and sensitivity of the personal data
The potential risk of harm from unauthorized use or disclosure
The purposes for which we process your personal data
Whether we can achieve those purposes through other means
The applicable legal requirements

international.title: 8. International Data Transfers
before: We may transfer, store, and process your information in countries other than your own. Our servers are primarily located in Egypt, but we may use service providers based in various locations globally.
If we transfer your personal data to countries outside your jurisdiction, we will take steps to ensure that your personal data receives an adequate level of protection, including through:
items: Using specific contracts approved for use in certain jurisdictions
Relying on certification schemes like the EU-US Privacy Shield
Obtaining your consent for these transfers where required

cookies.title: 9. Cookies and Tracking Technologies
before: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to track activity on our website and hold certain information. Cookies are files with a small amount of data which may include an anonymous unique identifier.
We use the following types of cookies:

items.label: Essential Cookies:
items.text: Necessary for the website to function properly.

items.label: Analytical/Performance Cookies:
items.text: Allow us to recognize and count the number of visitors and see how visitors move around our website.

items.label: Functionality Cookies:
items.text: Used to recognize you when you return to our website.

after: You can instruct your browser to refuse all cookies or to indicate when a cookie is being sent. However, if you do not accept cookies, you may not be able to use some portions of our website.

rights.title: 10. Your Rights
before: Depending on your location, you may have certain rights regarding your personal data, including:

items.label: Right to Access:
items.text: The right to request copies of your personal data.

items.label: Right to Rectification:
items.text: The right to request that we correct any inaccurate data about you.

items.label: Right to Erasure:
items.text: The right to request that we delete your personal data in certain circumstances.

items.label: Right to Restrict Processing:
items.text: The right to request that we restrict the processing of your personal data in certain circumstances.

items.label: Right to Data Portability:
items.text: The right to request that we transfer the data we have collected to another organization or directly to you.

items.label: Right to Object:
items.text: The right to object to our processing of your personal data in certain circumstances.

items.label: Rights Related to Automated Decision Making:
items.text: The right not to be subject to a decision based solely on automated processing.

after: To exercise any of these rights, please contact us using the information provided below. We may need to request specific information from you to help us confirm your identity and ensure your right to access your personal data.

children.title: 11. Children's Privacy
before: Our services are not intended for use by children under the age of 18, and we do not knowingly collect personal data from children under 18. If we learn we have collected or received personal data from a child under 18 without verification of parental consent, we will delete that information.

thirdParty.title: 12. Third-Party Links
before: Our website and applications may contain links to third-party websites or services that are not owned or controlled by SyvurSoft. We have no control over, and assume no responsibility for, the content, privacy policies, or practices of any third-party websites or services.

changes.title: 13. Changes to This Policy
before: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new privacy policy on this page and updating the "Last Updated" date at the top of this policy.
after: We encourage you to review this privacy policy periodically for any changes. Changes to this privacy policy are effective when they are posted on this page.

hero.title: Empowering <accent>Healthcare</accent> with Innovation

dialog.title: Book a Demo
dialog.text: You will be transferred to Contact to choose your preferred method of communication.

features.title: Meet <brand>RADex</brand>
features.description: The first decisive step into a fully unified medical system. We combine next-gen RIS, enterprise PACS, and a zero-footprint Viewer into one seamless engine, redefining speed and precision in diagnostic imaging.
features.beyond: Beyond RIS, <brand>RADex</brand> offers a comprehensive suite of modules to manage every aspect of your healthcare facility.

portal.title: Patient Portal
portal.description: Empower patients with secure online access to their images and reports. Reduce administrative workload with self-service features and automated result delivery.

radCatalogue.title: Radiology Catalogue
radCatalogue.description: Complete radiology service listing. Patients can search for scans, view procedure details, check availability, and self-schedule appointments 24/7.

labCatalogue.title: Lab Catalogue
labCatalogue.description: Comprehensive test menu access. Patients can browse available lab tests, check preparations instructions, view pricing, and book home visits or clinic slots instantly.

dashboard.title: Smart Dashboard
dashboard.description: Real-time practice analytics at a glance. Track patient volume, revenue trends, and modality, resource utilization with interactive charts. Make data-driven decisions instantly.

patients.title: Patient Management
patients.description: A 360-degree view of your patients. Manage demographics, insurance data, and prior history in one secure location. Quick search and automated merging of duplicate records.

emr.title: Electronic Medical Records
emr.description: A comprehensive digital health record for every patient. Access complete medical history, allergies, and contraindications in a single unified view.

history.title: Clinical History Timeline
history.description: Visual timeline of patient encounters, procedures, and prescriptions. Quickly understand the patient's clinical journey with an intuitive chronological display.

schedule.title: Intelligent Scheduling
schedule.description: Intuitive appointment management with conflict detection. Automated SMS/Email reminders reduce no-shows. Color-coded views for different modalities and rooms.

reception.title: User Friendly Interface
reception.description: A streamlined interface for efficient booking and check-in. Manage walk-ins, verify insurance, and handle patient queues with a dedicated, user-friendly dashboard.

worklist.title: Reservation System
worklist.description: Centralized control for all patient bookings. enhanced filtering and status tracking ensure every reservation is accounted for, reducing gaps and maximizing modality uptime.

clinicalWorklist.title: Worklist
clinicalWorklist.description: Unified clinical workspace. Upload imaging studies directly and enter lab results efficiently. Streamline your diagnostic workflow with quick access to all required inputs.

mwl.title: Modality Worklist
mwl.description: Automated seamless integration with imaging modalities. Eliminate manual data entry errors and ensure patient demographics match perfectly with DICOM headers.

templates.title: Flex Templates
templates.description: Flexible report templates with preset structures. Standardize reporting across your institution while saving time on repetitive formatting.

pacs.title: PACS Simplified
pacs.description: One search for all. Unified query and retrieve across all your DICOM nodes. Find any study, from any modality, instantly from a single powerful search bar.

viewer.title: Web DICOM Viewer
viewer.description: Zero-footprint diagnostic viewer. Perform MPR, MIP, and 3D reconstructions directly in your browser without installing any software.

reporting.title: Result & Report Writer
reporting.description: Advanced reporting module with customizable templates and rich text editing. Automatically incorporate patient data and measurements for professional, accurate reports.

print.title: Just Print
print.description: Simple, one-click printing to any device. Supports physical printers, PDF generation, and paperless workflows with zero configuration.

tracker.title: Staff Tracker & KPI
tracker.description: Monitor staff performance and operational efficiency in real-time. Track key performance indicators (KPIs), identify workflow bottlenecks, and optimize resource allocation for maximum productivity.

invoice.title: Billing & Invoicing
invoice.description: Automated invoicing linked directly to completed exams. Support for multiple insurance payers, split billing, and detailed financial audits to prevent revenue leakage.

accounting.title: Financial Accounting
accounting.description: Integrated financial management handling revenue cycles, expenses, and profit/loss statements. Generate comprehensive financial reports to monitor holistic practice health.

inventory.title: Inventory Control
inventory.description: Track medical supplies and contrast media efficiently. Automated alerts for low stock and expiration dates ensure you never run out of critical resources.

audit.title: Audit Trail & Security
audit.description: Comprehensive HIPAA-compliant logging of every user action. monitor system access, data modifications, and export activities to ensure complete security and compliance.

radex.title: RADex
radex.description: The complete radiology engine. Unified RIS, PACS, and Viewer for ultimate diagnostic speed and precision.

mend.title: MEND
mend.description: An adaptive medical-facility operating system that simulates the real facility and controls workflows from every corner.

adam.title: ADAM

cards.title: Admin command

cards.title: AI integration

cards.title: Maintenance covered

items.text: Trained by physicians and fine-tuned for clinical reasoning. Real medical intelligence, not generic text generation.

items.title: Auto-completion from workflow

items.text: Every action is logged, timestamped, and traceable. Full compliance without manual documentation effort.

labImaging.title: Complete lab. Complete PACS.
labImaging.description: A full laboratory information system and a complete PACS with the Mend viewer — view imaging exactly as it appears on the machine, directly inside the platform.

cards.text: Order tests, track samples, receive results, and integrate findings into the patient record. A full LIS inside Mend — no external system needed.

cards.text: View X-rays, CT scans, MRIs, and ultrasounds exactly as they appear on the imaging machine. No separate PACS software — it's all inside Mend.

admin.description: HR, payroll, sign-in, financial reporting, and employee self-service. Mend gives administrators complete operational visibility without leaving the platform.

cards.title: One-button payroll

cards.text: Innovative ways for signing in and out. Attendance tracked without friction.

cards.title: Financial reporting
